::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**GEE apps are planned.** This section will provide tools to explore and use the ground data, environmental covariates and maps. Until then, the [catalogue](index.qmd#find), [downloads](downloads.qmd) and the working examples below give direct access.
:::

**Working examples available now**

- **Earth Engine Code Editor:** [01_load_carbon_data.js](`r gh_blob("examples/01_load_carbon_data.js")`) loads the WoSIS profiles, SoilGrids depth bands and ESA CCI biomass.
- **Python:** [02_quickstart.py](`r gh_blob("examples/02_quickstart.py")`) makes read-only requests and downloads a small demonstration GeoTIFF ([instructions](`r gh_blob("examples/README.md")`)).
- **Exact Earth Engine asset IDs and provider links** for every map are in the [Assets table](`r gh_blob("data/downloads/Assets.csv")`).

You need an Earth Engine-enabled Cloud project of your own; public asset sharing does not give quota on the catalogue maintainer's project.

# Forests {#forests}

App forthcoming: explore forest plot and tree observations. For now, follow each dataset's [provider link](index.qmd#forests-ground).

## Covariates {#forests-covariates}

# Soils {#soils}

## Ground data {#soils-ground}
App forthcoming: explore soil profiles and cores. The five hosted profile tables are public Earth Engine assets listed in the [Ground data table](`r gh_blob("data/downloads/Ground_data.csv")`).

## Covariates {#soils-covariates}
App forthcoming: explore the environmental covariates soil and peat studies used. For now, see the [covariate summary](index.qmd#soils-covariates).

## Maps {#soils-maps}
App forthcoming: explore and extract soil and peat carbon maps. For now, the Python example shows how to read SoilGrids at a fixed depth with its documented unit factor.
